title: Ring of Restorative Gravity
summary: Early Access ring that pulled creatures toward you when you healed them.

fields.Early Access effect: Healing another creature pulled it 7 ft toward the wearer.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in the release version. Omeluum sold it in Early Access after the parasite quest. The release version replaced it with Ring of Salving.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
